notes.Food > Vegetables > Tomatoes: Includes cherry, roma, beefsteak, and all tomato varieties - group here by grocery-store convention even though botanically a fruit.
notes.Food > Vegetables > Cucumbers & Squash: Includes cucumbers, zucchini, pumpkin - also botanically fruits, group here anyway.
notes.Food > Dairy & Eggs > Yogurt: Includes yogurt, skyr, quark, and similar cultured dairy products.
notes.Food > Pantry > Spreads: Includes jam, honey, Nutella, peanut butter, chocolate spread, marmalade - anything spread on bread.
notes.Food > Pantry > Pasta & Rice: Includes fresh/refrigerated pasta too (Spätzle, Tortellini, etc.), not just dry pasta.
notes.Food > Snacks & Sweets > Nuts & Dried Fr: Includes nuts, seeds (chia, sunflower, pumpkin), and dried fruit.
notes.Food > Frozen & Ready Meals > Frozen Piz: Includes all frozen or chilled ready-to-bake pizza - not Bakery, even though it has bread-like dough.
notes.Food > Beverages > Beer: Includes all beer, including alcohol-free (alkoholfrei) beer - group by product type, not alcohol content.
notes.Other > Deposits & Refunds > Pfand: The deposit CHARGED when buying a bottle/container - item name is usually just 'Pfand', always a positive amount. Never merge into the drink it belongs to.
notes.Other > Deposits & Refunds > Returns & R: Empty bottles/containers being RETURNED for a refund - item name is usually 'Leergut', always negative or a refund. This is the opposite direction of Pfand, not the same thing.
notes.Personal Care > Cosmetics > Skincare: Includes body lotion, face cream, and moisturizers - even ones used in the bathroom/shower.
notes.Personal Care > Hygiene > Shower & Bath: Only soap, shower gel, and bath/wash products. Lotions and creams go under Cosmetics > Skincare instead.
notes.Other > Miscellaneous > General: Use only when genuinely unsure - flagged for manual review, not a dumping ground.
